meta.title: MODE Global — Office Locations
meta.description: Geocoded master directory of MODE / MODE Transportation offices, prepared for programmatic use, deployment, and handoff.

geocoding.notes: Records with geocode_method='zip_centroid' are at the ZIP centroid, not the exact street address. geocode_approximate=true flags these.

boundary_data.us_states: US Census via us-atlas@3 states-10m (1:10,000,000 TopoJSON, high resolution)
boundary_data.canada_provinces: click_that_hood Canada GeoJSON, reduced to ~3-decimal (~110 m) precision
boundary_data.rendering: D3 geoMercator fitted to the contiguous US; Great Lakes render as water gaps between state polygons; national border drawn from a TopoJSON mesh.

meta.known_omissions: Several malformed source-CSV rows (unquoted commas in the City field) could not be cleanly parsed and are excluded — notably a Ryan Hizey / 'NY OFFIC' record in Acton, MA. Fix the export and re-ingest to recover them.

schema.office_name: string — descriptive office label from source 'City' column
schema.global_id: string — MODE GlobalId / internal office code
schema.state: string — 2-letter US state or CA province code
schema.service_modes: array — normalized subset of [LTL, TL, IM, Air, Ocean, Parcel, Warehousing]

handoff.purpose: Hand off to Claude Code to host/deploy the map and own future data updates.
handoff.main_file: index.html — the current production map (high-resolution vector boundaries, mobile-friendly, fully self-contained, offline-capable). THIS is the file to deploy.
artifacts_already_built: index.html (a.k.a. MODE_Office_Map_HiRes.html) — MAIN FILE. D3 + embedded high-res US/Canada boundaries + embedded office data. Mobile layout stacks map over a scrollable list so both show at once on iPhone. No runtime network deps except the per-office Google Maps Directions link.
MODE_Office_Finder.html — earlier online version using Leaflet + map tiles (richer street basemap, needs internet). Optional alternate.
MODE_Office_Locations_OFFLINE.html — earlier offline build, superseded by index.html.
suggested_next_steps: Deploy index.html to Netlify as the site root (see DEPLOY_TO_NETLIFY.md).
Wire index.html to read this mode_offices.json at build time so data lives in one place (it is currently embedded inline).
Add an ingestion script: re-parse the source CSV, re-geocode only new/changed rows, regenerate this JSON, then re-inject into index.html.
Fix the malformed source rows (see meta.known_omissions) to recover excluded offices.
Optional: correct coordinates for the ZIP-centroid records flagged below.

field_to_map_key_mapping.note: index.html uses short keys internally; map JSON fields when wiring.

data_quality_flags: Verify Sean Hizey vs Ryan Hizey (same office/last name, different first name).
Coraopolis, Sotx, and Corp Sales resolved to one office (PA-KU319) — confirm distinct vs duplicate.
14 offices are positioned by ZIP centroid (geocode_approximate=true).
